::: {.callout-important title="Available-case modified ITT contrast"}
This available-case modified ITT estimate compares children by their assigned arm. It uses the archived cohort of 54 children from the 57 randomised, then applies the model's observation requirements. A causal interpretation assumes that archive inclusion and outcome observation do not select children by their potential outcomes differently between arms, conditional on the stated pre-treatment information. Randomisation alone does not ensure this after selection. Extending the result to all 57 children needs further missing-outcome assumptions and sensitivity analysis. Baseline and age are precision terms; they do not repair selection. The ITT model does not adjust for post-assignment attendance or dose. Positive contrasts mean higher modelled outcomes in the immediate arm. See [the methods](../../METHODS.md#2-bayesian-statistical-models) for participant flow and timing qualifications.
:::
